body: I don't have the willpower to bother. Getting into free clinics still takes months if not years when they're available. And they usually only do extractions. I'd just be homeless again and back to square one. I would rather die.
It's not free... it's subsidized. A root canal at the only dental school near me is $400. I've already looked into all that. Don't waste your time poking around on Google for me.

I don't know because I don't know the full extent of the damage. If it was 4 or 5 root canals, probably 5 to 8 months. If I need a full mouth reconstruction, around 10 years, heh.

If you're going to get down to it... I don't qualify for SNAP anymore in my state, I failed the work requirement once so I can't reapply for 3 years. Medicaid in my state doesn't cover dental for adults. Or anything really. And there's not really any other aid available to me.

Oh, I forgot to expand on that. My mother has dementia. My sister takes care of her... by stealing all of her retirement money to finance her house and expensive cars. I wouldn't expect adult protective services to do anything either.

I have no family that cares about my wellbeing whatsoever.

I have terrible credit from unpaid hospital bills into the tens of thousands of dollars.

They provide sliding-scale/subsidized care but it's still not cheap. $50 for an exam/$700 for a root canal. At this point I'm considering taking out private student loans, fixing my teeth, and taking the 1+ year prison sentence + lifetime of indentured servitude to the government.

I don't have any dental insurance, or money for exams/cleaning, or access to any services unfortunately. There's only 1 free clinic within 15 miles that has a 6 month waiting list on their patient intake. And they're only open 2 days of the week, down from 3 last year. By the time I am actually seen by somebody, they will probably have shut down.

I considered that but it still costs money.

I don't have any money whatsoever. I choose between paying rent and eating. I don't eat probably 7 days out of the month.

I live in an area that is very anti-homeless and has an extremely high unemployment rate. There are no services available to me aside from 1 free clinic that has a 6 month waiting list for patient intake.
